business_problem: Megacable's business teams waited days or weeks for IT to answer data questions, while legacy APIs took 1 to 2 minutes to return subscriber context to live voice agents and could stop responding at peak call volumes.
solution_summary: Megacable runs the Databricks Data + AI Platform on AWS to serve two connected workloads: self-service analytics and low-latency context for AI voice agents. Source-system data is transformed through bronze, silver and gold layers, curated as governed tables in Unity Catalog, and published to Lakebase Postgres as agent-ready subscriber context. The agents retrieve balances, debt details and offers through data APIs during calls; Lakebase separates compute from storage and autoscaling keeps those APIs responsive at peak traffic. In parallel, business data owners use Genie Agents for operational questions and Genie One skills to bind business context to approved data sources and return consistent KPI answers; Genie Code assists engineers, while AI/BI Dashboards combine census and customer records for prospect mapping. Dedicated API schemas and per-agent service principals constrain access.
